sql: /* Query 5: filter3_join1 (player, team) */ SELECT player.mvp_awards, team.championship, player.draft_year, team.team_name FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name WHERE team.location <> 'Los Angeles' OR team.founded_year < 1967

draft_year.description: the year the player was selected in the NBA draft; use format YYYY (e.g., 2003).

mvp_awards.description: number of NBA MVP awards the player has won; use 0 if none (e.g., 2).

championship.description: championships is the number of this team getting championships (e.g. 5).

team_name.description: team_name is the full name of the team (e.g. Los Angeles Lakers).
